content: I have a sequence of f-many members a_i. I also have a_i not equal a_j when i not equal j. What is the name of the lemma that would show an injection from [1..f] into {a_i : 1<=i<=f}?
sender_full_name: J. J. Issai (project started by GRP)

content:
Eric Wieser said:

Can you state that as a #mwe ?

Not yet. If I try making a #mwe it seems like a tautology. I think I am actually trying to get at a kind of pigeonhole principle. I will look at my source problem more closely and try to convey it here.
sender_full_name: J. J. Issai (project started by GRP)

content: This looks like the definition of injective, your map is a.
The definition of Injective doesn't use "not equal", so this is not a syntactic tautology
